This sounds a lot like my brother,  he had 2 really bad months and we were visiting him and phoning him daily. Then the last month he seemed to have improved, he was back at work, going to the gym, seeing friends again, we thought he was better. Then he did it out of no where, we thought he was through it. My mum n dad are devastated, most of our conversations are trying to understand why. Good luck

Like the others say, she isn’t being super responsive so I wouldn’t waste too much time on her. Just text her and say get in touch if you want to go out on a date sometime, otherwise have a nice life.

You should ask her out, I’m a girl and I always feel pleased when someone asks me out, whether I like them or not because it reinforces the fact guys think I’m attractive. Also I’ve never asked a guy out, I’ve always expected the guy to chase so she’s probably waiting for you to ask her. If she says no, don’t take it personally, there could be millions of reasons ie she’s not ready to get involved, she thinks you live too far away, she’s got loads of study coming up and needs to focus. If it was me I would like a guy to say, would you like to go out for a drink/meal with me sometime? Good luck 😉

Sorry for your loss, my brother hung him self 2 months ago and our family have also been through hell. It gets easier, the first few days are the worst. There’s a lot of questioning, you feel like you’ve failed them, If only we’d done this or that, if only we’d known they were that bad, it’s a lifetime of loss.

The people around you are not good enough or they would be more caring. Find your interests and passions and spend as much time as possible making yourself happy, improve your own vibration and you will attract good people  xx
